design_constitution: v1.6/v2 rendering and design contracts preserved; v3 application platform + Waves 58–76 canonical data/analysis/semiconductor/certification/promotion/operations/longitudinal/review authorities. Wave 77 is consolidation-only: it audits authority ownership, release metadata, generated-project guidance, wheel/source/package representation and stable-qualification handoff boundaries without creating a parallel evidence authority or manufacturing company target PASS.
